name: Nirvana

whyMatters.en: Underground noise becomes a global language while the band refuses rock-hero cosplay—after Teen Spirit, alternative has a new default face.
whyMatters.zh: 地下噪声变成全球语言，乐队却拒绝摇滚英雄扮相——Teen Spirit 之后，「另类」有了新的默认表情。

note.zh: 安静—爆发成为一代人的共享语法
疏离钩子：另类进入主流电台
脆弱与反偶像并存的尾声气质

interviewQuotes.text: I'd rather be hated for who I am, than loved for who I am not.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Kurt Cobain
interviewQuotes.source: Widely circulated interview excerpt · quote wall

interviewQuotes.text: We don't want to be the next Beatles. We just want to be Nirvana.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Krist Novoselic

lyricQuotes: All in all is all we are

shortBio.en: Underground noise made global—while refusing to play rock hero.
shortBio.zh: 把地下噪声推成全球语言，同时拒绝扮演摇滚英雄。

body.en:
Nirvana's weight is not only sales. They rewrite the nineties face: quiet-loud dynamics, anti-idol contradiction, the nausea when alternative suddenly owns the mall.

Punk bite inside Hard Rock mass—and a public refusal to enjoy the crown.
body.zh:
Nirvana 的分量不只是销量。他们改写九十年代的表情：安静—爆发、反偶像矛盾、「另类」突然占领商场时的恶心感。

Hard Rock 体量里的 Punk 咬合——以及公开拒绝享受那顶王冠。

body.en:
After Teen Spirit, underground and mainstream briefly share a wall. Nirvana matter because they open Hard Rock weight with punk roughness, then refuse the hero script that usually follows.

The chronicle gains a new type: fame that looks allergic to itself.
body.zh:
Teen Spirit 之后，地下与主流短暂共用一面墙。Nirvana 要紧，因为他们用朋克粗糙咬开 Hard Rock 重量，却拒绝通常随之而来的英雄剧本。

编年史多了一种类型：对自己过敏的成名。

body.en:
Cobain, Novoselic, Grohl—the classic trio locks a fingerprint fast. Earlier drummers matter to collectors; the world remembers the chemistry that hit MTV like a weather event.

Short life, permanent silhouette.
body.zh:
Cobain、Novoselic、Grohl——经典三人组很快锁死声纹。早期鼓手留给收藏家；世界记得那化学作用像天气砸进 MTV。

生命短，剪影永久。

title.en: Teen Spirit: a shared body memory

body.en:
Quiet-loud is not new tech. MTV and radio amplify it until a Seattle trio becomes a generation's muscle memory—cheerleader satire included.

The medium system turns a local band into an era switch. You can still feel the drop in your shoulders.
body.zh:
安静—爆发不是新技术。MTV 与电台把它放大，直到西雅图三人组成为一代人的肌肉记忆——包括啦啦队讽刺。

媒介系统把一支本地乐队变成时代开关。你肩膀里还能感到那一下落下。

title.en: Melody, sludge, and a drum hit like a door
title.zh: 旋律、淤泥，与像踹门的鼓

body.en:
Cobain's tunes under the noise, Novoselic's elastic low end, Grohl's kick that arrives like news. In a short run they brand a sound later bands copy as dynamics alone.

What they cannot copy is the reluctance—the face that won and looked trapped.
body.zh:
噪声下的 Cobain 旋律，Novoselic 有弹性的低频，Grohl 像新闻抵达的底鼓。短周期里他们烙印一种声音，后来乐队常只抄动态。

抄不走的是不情愿——赢了却像被困住的表情。

body.en:
Interview negation beside stage explosion. Short lines on the wall keep the oral tension without turning tragedy into merch.

Listen for the argument inside the fame: that argument is the legacy's sharp edge.
body.zh:
访谈里的否定，挨着舞台上的爆发。墙上的短句保留口述张力，不把悲剧做成周边。

去听成名内部的争吵：那争吵才是遗产的锋刃。

body.en:
Britpop answers with brightness. Indie keeps DIY. Radiohead chooses evolution over repeating the flannel costume.

Nirvana remain the nineties hinge: the modern axis turns here, whether later bands salute or flee.
body.zh:
Britpop 用明亮回答。Indie 守住 DIY。Radiohead 选择进化，而非复读法兰绒戏服。

Nirvana 仍是九十年代铰链：近代主轴在此转弯，后来者无论致敬还是逃离。

note.en: Bleach-era continuum before the peak trio.
note.zh: 巅峰三人组之前的 Bleach 时期连续统。

note.en: The version the world remembers—and Grohl's launchpad out.
note.zh: 世界记住的版本——也是 Grohl 向外跳的跳板。

note.en: Underground ethics collide with MTV scale overnight.
note.zh: 地下伦理一夜撞上 MTV 尺度。
